**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. "I'm always running out of cloud context when..."

- How will this map to requirements in `requirements.json`?
- What acceptance criteria and MC/DC test vectors will verify it?

**Additional context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
